script: Kyoto is a city where old traditions meet modern life. Walk through the red gates of Fushimi Inari as the morning mist lifts from the hills. Visit a quiet bamboo forest where tall green stalks sway in the wind. Watch a tea master prepare matcha in a wooden teahouse. In the evening, lanterns glow along the narrow streets of Gion. Take the train to Osaka for street food, or stay and enjoy the calm.
